## Activity

River Outreach recorded 76 captures during May 2019. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and establishes the volume submitted for review. The activity figure should be considered alongside the image-quality and grading results below. No further activity detail is recorded in this report.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 7 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 9.2 per cent. This indicates that a small proportion of the images could not be assessed and may require attention to capture conditions or equipment performance. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead, to support follow-up and monitoring.

## Grading

There were 9 referable results. The median grading wait was 0, indicating no recorded delay at the midpoint of the grading results. The activity, image-quality and grading measures should continue to be reviewed together so that any operational issues can be identified and addressed promptly.
